mafia.name: Mafia
mafia.description: Mafia scores Townsperson icons; Warlock siphons Gold for the family. Both halved by their respective penalty cards.

town.name: Town
town.description: Score Gold icons; halved if you capture a Mafia card.

roleInfo.name: Townsperson
roleInfo.description: You score Gold cards. Avoid taking Mafia cards — they halve your Gold score.

roleInfo.name: Mafia
roleInfo.description: You score Townsperson cards. Avoid taking Daggers — they halve your Townsperson score.

roleInfo.name: Warlock
roleInfo.description: On team Mafia, but you score Gold like a Townsperson — your gold gets credited to the Mafia team total. Mafia cards still halve your score.

params.name: format
params.value: ($1) — a trick-taking game with hidden Mafia roles. Each round you'll be dealt a fresh role from the cards.

params.name: format
params.value: ($1), who needs the tutorial? Click on the players or select from the middle.

params.name: format
params.value: Each round you'll be dealt cards. Look for the Mafia / Warlock / Police Officer in your hand — that determines your secret role. Town & Warlock score Gold; Mafia scores Townsperson. Play tricks to collect points.

params.name: format
params.value: Opposite suit beats lead suit! If Gold is led, a Townsperson 1 beats a Gold 15. Watch the LEAD and TRUMP indicators on the board.

params.name: format
params.value: Mafia card: 16 of trump (reveals you!) or +1 from previous. Police Officer: 16 of trump, unless Mafia is played — then 0 of lead. Warlock: 16 of lead. Dagger: 0 of trump (halves Mafia score if Mafia takes it).

params.name: format
params.value: Dealer: ($1). Each player just received ($2) cards — check your hand for Mafia, Warlock, or Police Officer.

preset.text: Roles revealed below. Each player's per-round contribution shown next to their score.
